title: Slope Extra
desc: Slope Extra keeps the classic downhill loop alive: steer a accelerating ball along raised ramps, read the next gap early and survive as the pace builds. It is a quick, focused alternative run for Speed Slope players.
howto: Follow the ramp and keep the ball near a safe lane.
Steer left and right as the slope accelerates.
Avoid blocks, edges and sudden changes in the track.
Use straight sections to reset your position.
Chase a longer run after every fall.
tips: Make small corrections instead of wide swerves.
Return to center when the track opens up.
